# IBN Technologies – Cybersecurity, Cloud, Finance & Accounting, AI, SAP, and Outsourced Business Services

> IBN Technologies is an ISO-certified (ISO 9001:2015, ISO 20000-1:2018, ISO 27001:2022) global outsourcing and digital transformation partner, founded in 1999 and registered in the United States, United Kingdom, and India, with a Global Delivery Center in Pune, India. Trusted by 2,500+ clients across the USA, UK, India, the Middle East and beyond, IBN Technologies offers an integrated portfolio of Cybersecurity, Cloud, Finance and Accounting, Construction Engineering, BPO, AI, and SAP services, helping organizations manage critical business and technology functions through a single service provider.

## Cybersecurity Services
- [Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT)](https://www.ibntech.com/vapt-services/): AI-enhanced penetration testing and quantum-resilient methodologies to identify and remediate security gaps with compliance-ready reporting.
- [Managed SIEM and SOC Services](https://www.ibntech.com/managed-siem-soc-services/): 24/7 AI-powered Security Operations Center for continuous monitoring, threat intelligence, incident response, and audit-ready reporting.
- [Managed Detection and Response (MDR)](https://www.ibntech.com/managed-detection-response-services/): Machine learning-driven threat hunting, behavioral analytics, automated response, and deep forensics for rapid threat containment.
- [vCISO Services](https://www.ibntech.com/vciso-services/): Virtual CISO expertise providing strategic cybersecurity leadership, risk and compliance oversight, board-level reporting, and security roadmaps.
- [Managed Microsoft Security Services](https://www.ibntech.com/microsoft-security-services/): Expert management of identity and access control, threat protection, and cloud compliance across Azure and Microsoft 365 environments.
- [Cyber Security Maturity Risk Assessment](https://www.ibntech.com/cybersecurity-maturity-assessment-services/): Risk identification, gap analysis, security controls evaluation, and governance insights to strengthen security posture.
- [Compliance Management and Audit Services](https://www.ibntech.com/cybersecurity-audit-compliance-services/): Services to help organizations stay compliant with regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and SOC 2.
- [SOC 2 Compliance](https://www.ibntech.com/soc-2-compliance/): Support for achieving and proving SOC 2 compliance.
